one_line: Pursue clarification because sanitation services fit our capabilities, but this expiring-contract forecast lacks a current solicitation and confirmed equipment requirements.
scope: CAL FIRE needs portable toilet services in California for fiscal years 2025 and 2026. The supplied notice is an expiring-contract forecast with no attachments; it does not specify quantities, locations, servicing frequency, or whether restroom trailers qualify.
fit: Portable sanitation, restroom facilities, water delivery, waste removal, and maintenance are stated capabilities.
Denver restroom-trailer work demonstrates related cleaning, pump-outs, waste disposal, supplies, and maintenance.
No set-aside is stated, so the notice presents no identified conflict with our SBE/MBE status.
red_flags: This is a forecast, not a supplied solicitation with actionable submission instructions.
The FY2025–2026 scope conflicts with the listed December 2027 response deadline; the procurement schedule needs confirmation.
NAICS 562991 is not listed in the company profile; solicitation PSC is not provided.
The fleet includes restroom trailers, but conventional portable toilet inventory and required capacity are unconfirmed.
Site visits, bonding, licenses, and contract-specific experience requirements are not provided.
competition: No incumbent, past winner, or offer count is supplied. The bid pack found no agency awards or broader benchmarks under NAICS 562991.
price_signal: The forecast lists an estimated value of 65,520–65,520, with currency and pricing basis unstated; this is not a verified award price. Our $78,500 USCG award included housing and sanitation and is not a direct portable-toilet comparison.
